column_description: BIGSERIAL. Auto-generated unique identifier for membership and spending record. PK = MembershipAndSpending(Member_Reg).
TEXT. Reference to the fan user for this membership record. FK to Fans.
TEXT. Type or tier of membership subscription held by the fan.
SMALLINT. Duration of current membership in days since activation.
REAL. Total amount spent by fan on platform in USD.
TEXT. Frequency pattern of spending behavior by the fan.
TEXT. Preferred payment method used for transactions.
TEXT. Daily spending velocity and financial engagement rate. Example: 32.296185365657216 USD/day.
TEXT. Monthly spending projection based on current patterns. Example: 208.84866536458333 USD/month.
TEXT. Value-to-cost ratio for membership and spending efficiency. Example: 85 value/USD.
